# Connor Abdelnoor

> Impactful software engineer with experience designing scalable enterprise software from user interfaces to infrastructure. Equally adept at leading high-performing teams and driving progress on business objectives. Collaborated with CEOs, Business Owners, and Executive Teams to translate strategic goals into technical requirements and deliver solutions that provide meaningful value.

Connor Abdelnoor is a software engineer in Lebanon, New Hampshire.
He spent eleven years in Portland building e-commerce infrastructure, first at the agencies Copious and Ergon Tech, then five years at LaCrosse Footwear.
He now runs Monochrome Technologies, a consulting practice focused on B2B platforms, AI integration, and infrastructure.
He is passionate about team building with a focus on accountability, fostering leadership, and creating a shared sense of purpose.

## Pages

- [Home](https://connorabdelnoor.github.io/): Current projects and a random printer fact.
- [About](https://connorabdelnoor.github.io/about): Photos, and a short note on life in New England and an old house.
- [Portfolio](https://connorabdelnoor.github.io/portfolio): Points to the AI agent at connorabdelnoor.com, which answers questions about Connor's work.
- [Monochrome](https://connorabdelnoor.github.io/monochrome): Monochrome Technologies, Connor's consulting practice.

## Current Projects

- [AI Agent Portfolio](https://connorabdelnoor.com): A RAG-based AI agent trained to answer questions about Connor. Built with Pinecone, Gemini, a React frontend, self-hosted N8N for workflows, OpenTofu for IaC, and hosted on AWS within the free tier.
- [Upper Valley Tech](https://uppervalleytech.org): A community organization Connor founded to bring together tech folk in the Upper Valley for socializing, mentorship, and special events.
- [Lebanon Data Project](https://lebanondataproject.org): Work in progress. ETL pipelines over Lebanon, NH town data with Apache Airflow and MongoDB, reports in S3, and a React frontend.
